''See also: [[Chronicler (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Chronicler is a professional role within the [[Guild]] responsible for witnessing, recording, and disseminating [[Imperial]] history. Individuals in this position, such as [[Naberius Clayborn]], may also serve as keepers of the [[Imperial Palace treasury]]. Historically, [[Chroniclers]] have managed financial records and used those resources to maintain the Capital and fund the [[Imperial Guard]]. The role often involves traveling the [[Aion]] and may include a [[Silent One]], who acts as a bodyguard and guide while remaining mute to protect secrets. Beyond historical documentation, the position can involve deep research into Elder biology and the ability to understand the language of the [[Children]] through contact with the [[Heart of Nakothi]]. Some [[Chroniclers]] have used their knowledge and resources to attempt to stabilize The Empire{{!}}the Empire by seeking to install a new Emperor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Naberius Clayborn]], also known as The Chronicler, carries a belt of wax candles at his waist. He has been seen staggering to his feet while clutching the [[Heart of Nakothi]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Chronicler is a person who may have control over Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss. There is speculation that he might deserve the [[throne]] if it is a sentence of insanity and death.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|He is an impressively skilled Reader. Additionally, he possesses the capability to write notes with great speed.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Reader on the ship}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Chronicler is an impressively skilled Reader who travels as a character aboard the ship.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref> This individual possesses knowledge of a unique treasure belonging to the Emperor that has never been entrusted to anyone else.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref> After staggering to his feet while clutching the [[Heart of Nakothi]], the Chronicler wailed upon losing the artifact.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref> While present at the table, it is suggested that the Chronicler may hold control over Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref> If the current situation results in a sentence of death and insanity, the Chronicler might be someone who deserves the [[throne]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}
